title: Image Data Quality and Finite-Value Repair
prompt:
Implement `analyze_image_dataset(images)` for a sequence of NumPy image arrays. Classify a 2-D image or a one-channel final axis as `gray`, a final axis of length three as `color`, and all other shapes as `unknown`. A noisy image has any NaN or infinite value. Return a mapping with per-image types, noisy indices, noisy rate, a cleaned copy of every image, and a short quality summary. Replace invalid values with that image's finite-value mean; if an image has no finite values, replace them with zero.

Handle an empty dataset and never mutate the supplied arrays.

example.output: one gray image with finite cleaned pixels
example.reasoning: Per-image repair avoids using values from unrelated images.
